feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Race 8 (entityR2B, 742.12) is the best result: body_length 0.12 m gave oval 20/20, s-bend 20/20 and slalom 2/20. Race 9 (entityR2B, 700.30) tested wheel_track 0.10 m and lost the slalom finishes (2 to 0) while raising slalom line loss to 1.25, so the yaw-gain increase did not help slalom. I am reverting to your race 8 platform exactly, as your own fallback said. The race 9 s-bend gain (20/20, line loss 0.2) shows the narrower track helps that track, but slalom is the limit. My controller change is kd 0.6 to 0.8 with kp 3.2 and base_speed 0.95 held, which tests whether more damping reduces slalom line loss at the direction reversals. Once race 10 reports: if slalom line loss falls to 1.0 or below and finishes hold or rise, keep the race 8 geometry and tune base_speed for time. If slalom line loss is unchanged or worse, the controller response is not the whole story, so hold the geometry and I will ask for a single exploration of mass at 0.6 kg in a later race, not combined with any other change. Keep wheel_track at 0.12 m.
requested_changes: Hold the race 8 platform exactly, with wheel_track 0.12 m, five 16 mm sensors at x = -0.03 to +0.03, y = 0.06, body_length 0.12 m, mass 0.8 kg, so race 10 is read against race 8.

If slalom line loss stays at 1.0 or more after this race, do not change geometry in the same step. Test mass 0.6 kg alone in a later race, as you proposed, to cut yaw inertia and traction-limited turning.
Do not return to wheel_track 0.10 m for slalom, since race 9 showed it lost finishes (2 to 0) and raised line loss (1.0 to 1.25).
